profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for sustainability and a background in filmmaking/teaching.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mid Level
positions.description:
•SWE III - August 2023- current
•SWE II - May 2022- August 2023

•Mid Level Full Stack Web Developer with expertise in crafting dynamic, scalable applications using cutting edge technologies.

•Specialize in designing and orchestrating seamless third-party API integrations, contributing to enhanced functionality and user experience.

•Collaborate closely with cross-functional business operations teams, translating product requirements into innovative tools and features that drive operational efficiency and deliver tangible business value.

•Provide thorough code reviews to fellow engineers, ensuring adherence to best practices and promoting code quality.

•Technically lead engineers on multiple projects from start to finish, driving successful project delivery and fostering a collaborative team environment.

•Proficient in Typescript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with a robust skill set encompassing AWS services such as Lambda, S3, EventBridge, and EC2, along with proficiency in Kafka for stream processing.

•Utilize Jest for comprehensive testing suites, ensuring the reliability and quality of the codebase.

•Meticulously monitor system performance through advanced logging with DataDog.

•Validate API integrations seamlessly using tools like Insomnia and Postman.

•Assisted the director on shoots.
•Helped coordinate shoot logistics with producers
•Assisted editors during post production.

positions.title: Community Engagement Board-Special Projects Chair
positions.description: As a hired member of C-Board, I was part of a small group of people who planned events for Pratt students and faculty with the sole purpose of community outreach. My job was to create and plan uncommon ways to get the student body involved. This job honed my event planning skill sets, including professional communication and organization, as well as allowed me to exercise my creativity in a very positive way. In addition to event planning, I also lead our social media presence by managing the monthly newsletter and the C-Board blogs.

positions.title: Freshman Orientation Coordinator
positions.description: Programmed and lead the 2012 freshman orientation at Pratt Institute. This involved months of event planning and staff training. Before getting hired for this position, I worked on the orientation staff from 2010-2012.

positions.title: Assistant Programmer
positions.description: I interned at UnionDocs in the spring of 2011. UnionDocs is a nonprofit cinema/gallery space in Brooklyn that screens documentary work presented by the artist(s). At UnionDocs I managed the online presence and assisted in all of the programming correspondence.

volunteerExperiences.description: Read with children who were falling behind in public school in an effort to help them improve their reading comprehension skills.

The Sean Casey Animal Rescue is a no-kill shelter with an abundance of cats and dogs. Some of which the shelter workers have to nurse back to health. I've volunteered there as a dog worker and an animal aide, assisting with administering medicine and feeding the animals.
